messages.subject: Eclipse day
messages.body: Today Earth passes between the Sun and the Moon. For a while our panels will see almost nothing. Plan with the facts you have, and show the forecast before committing.

messages.subject: The lamp is still here
messages.body: Kai found the hand light without looking at the label. Battery charged by measurement, clipped to his belt. The lamp still matters, and so does asking for company.

messages.subject: Protected list
messages.body: Guide light goes on the protected list, next to air circulation, minimum heat and dim growth light.

messages.subject: A memory with a switch
messages.body: I shared one log about a storm when I was small. I did not know when the light would return. This time we can read the plan, and the guide light runs through every segment.

messages.subject: Label the limits
messages.body: A forecast still has limits. We will label them on the board, as Kai asked.

messages.subject: Five segments
messages.body: Precharge, ingress, totality, egress, recovery. Essentials travel in every segment as one protected package. The rehearsal forecast spends nothing: compare before you commit.

messages.subject: Pump once, camera once
messages.body: Amara's rule for tonight: pump once, camera once. Everything else waits for the Sun.

messages.subject: Small light, protected supply
messages.body: I wanted the whole corridor bright. The preview shows the floods cost more than the plan can spare. A small labelled guide light gives a known way through instead. Small light. Protected supply.

messages.subject: Keep that way
messages.body: Keep the guide-light branch in the plan. I walked it twice with the label on; I can find the garden in the dark.

messages.subject: Test panel
messages.body: A rehearsal pass does not sign the watch.

messages.subject: Fault predicted, fault found
messages.body: Test branch disconnected, the predicted indicator changed and essentials stayed on. Bring your checks to the table: ready has to be a shared word.

messages.subject: Ready means all of us
messages.body: Plants, atmosphere, shelter, lamp and local channel: all checked by the people who checked them. The filtered camera is protected and ready.

messages.subject: Watch on the monitor
messages.body: Watch the eclipse on the filtered camera monitor. It is a protected instrument view; never look at the Sun directly, even when it is mostly covered.

messages.subject: Every sunrise and sunset at once
messages.body: The ring is real. Sunlight passing through Earth's air turns red at the edge, like every sunrise and sunset at once. Kai said home helps us understand the dark.

messages.subject: Home
messages.body: Home helps us understand the dark.

messages.subject: A call within the window
messages.body: The path check passed, so I called home inside the window. They asked if someone was here with me. I said the whole crew, and a plan. Rafi said hello from the lamp department.

messages.subject: Text packet
messages.body: Aurora, Earth desk. A text packet is on its way through the checked link. It is signed N.

messages.subject: Red ring
messages.body: I watched a red ring from there once. — N.

messages.subject: Saved locally
messages.body: Observation saved locally, camera state included. If the feed drops, the record does not.

messages.subject: We know that name
messages.body: We know that name now: Noor. The earlier date of her red ring stays unspecified, and we will not guess it.

messages.subject: F2 isolated
messages.body: The view screen dropped; essentials held. The fault was camera feeder F2, not the habitat. Isolated, checked, reset. The camera image is back before the last observation gate.

messages.subject: Stayed on the channel
messages.body: My hand went to the lamp first. Then I read the indicators. Rafi stayed on the channel the whole time.

messages.subject: Egress is a result
messages.body: Egress recorded. The interruption stays in the record. I was afraid, and I still followed the steps. The lamp is back in its clip.

messages.subject: Repeatable
messages.body: You stayed on the channel and kept the failure in the report. That is something you can repeat.

messages.subject: That region needs watching
messages.body: This morning's solar image shows an active region. I pinned it to the calendar. It is a reason to watch, not a forecast of a storm date.

messages.subject: Breakfast
messages.body: Rafi stood up from breakfast without a joke and went straight to the monitoring calendar. Whatever he saw, I want the shelter checklist on the table by noon.
